d: A struggling young baker in no mood for the holidays returns to her small hometown, where her festive family and a handsome farmer try to get her back in the Christmas spirit.

Rival Christmas tree farms, run by the Spruce and the Pine families, have always competed. When Julie Pine and Rick Spruce fall in love, they must conceal their romance or risk condemnation from their families.

Haley escapes her small-town and builds a life in Los Angeles as a wedding planner. When her sister asks her to plan her wedding, Haley returns to her childhood town and reunites with a childhood flame.
Workaholic Carrie plans to elope before her sister’s Christmas Eve wedding to keep control of the family business. But Carrie forgot to plan on love.
A runaway bride does some soul-searching when she’s trapped in a snowed-in cabin with her grandmother and an old flame at Christmas.
Two co-workers agree to a loveless marriage of convenience, but as they become acquainted, an unrealized chemistry grows between them.

A superintendent must fire the town's favorite music teacher to meet budget cuts. But a romance grows between them, and through the power of music, he discovers how instrumental a single individual can become in our lives.
After not seeing his family for years, P.J. gets talked into going home for Christmas.

How will 3 sisters save the Shakespeare Chateau, historic mansion and beloved family home, from a corrupt bank that threatens to foreclose on Christmas Day? Especially when one of them falls in love with one of the bankers.
When work moves Jason across the world, the only way he can bring his love Carla, is if they are married.
